name: Field Day
tagline: Turn your team offsite into the moment your company outgrows itself.
positioning: Field Day is the end-to-end offsite platform for owner-operators — venues, agendas, logistics, and outcomes in one command center.

hero.h1: Every great company has a before and after offsite.
hero.sub: Field Day gives owner-operators one platform to plan, run, and measure the offsite that resets the entire trajectory of the business — no spreadsheets, no chaos, no regrets.

features.title: Venue command center
features.description: Compare 4,000+ vetted retreat venues by budget, headcount, and vibe. Hold dates, sign contracts, and track deposits without leaving the tab.

features.title: Agenda that earns its keep
features.description: Build hour-by-hour agendas from proven offsite templates. Assign owners, attach docs, and keep every session tied to a real business objective.

features.title: Logistics on autopilot
features.description: Flights, rooming lists, dietary needs, and ground transport reconcile themselves. Your ops person gets their weekend back.

features.title: Live headcount & budget
features.description: Watch RSVPs, costs, and per-seat spend update in real time. No surprise invoices three weeks after everyone flew home.

features.title: Outcome tracking
features.description: Capture decisions and action items in the room, then push them to owners with due dates the moment the offsite ends.

features.title: Post-offsite pulse
features.description: Automated surveys and a one-page recap prove ROI to yourself, your board, and your team — before momentum fades.

testimonials.quote: We used to plan our annual offsite in six frantic email threads. Field Day turned it into two afternoons of setup — and it was the first retreat where every decision actually shipped.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The budget dashboard alone paid for itself. I knew our per-seat cost to the dollar before I approved a single deposit.
testimonials.name: Daniel Okafor

testimonials.quote: My team came back from the offsite aligned for the first time in years. Field Day made me look like I'd hired a full events department.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For first-time offsites and lean teams running one retreat a year.
For growing teams that treat offsites as a strategic ritual.
For multi-location operators running offsites across the year.

homepage.footerBlurb: Field Day is the offsite platform for owner-operators who believe a room full of the right people can change everything.
